description: Search your contacts by name, phone number or email, or with none of those, list them (newest changes first). A list shows contacts someone saved; set `unsaved` for the ones Blujay added on its own when you texted or called.

cursor.description: When listing: next_cursor from a previous call, for the next page.

unsaved.description: When listing: show the contacts nobody has saved yet instead of saved ones.

name: find_contacts
title: Find contacts
